title: Hotel Equity Stake For Sale in Baluwapati Deupur, Nepal
tagline: Public hotel company located in Baluwapati Deupur village near Nagarkot, Kavrepalanchok, positioned as an upscale mountain resort with stunning Himalayan views. - The first phase is completed and the resort started operations 2 years ago. We require investment to begin the second phase now. - The total project cost for second phase is NPR 75 crore (project cost NPR 73 crore, and NPR 2 crore working capital). - The resort is funded mainly through paid-up capital with promoters and public shareholders, supplemented by a bank loan of NPR 13 crore planned to be fully repaid using new promoter equity. - Financial projections after implementation of second phase indicate an IRR of 17.76%, simple payback period of 7.24 years and discounted payback period of 13.29 years. - The resort focuses on luxury stays, wellness, recreation, and eco-cultural tourism, targeting both domestic and international tourists while planning corporate-focused facilities such as a business centre and multipurpose halls. Currently has an occupancy rate of 40-50%. - The resort has Department of Tourism approval, mandatory food business license from the Department of Food Technology and Quality Control (DFTQC).
